text_block_list.text: The day of the Mile CS Nambu Hai—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hokko Tarumae made her return to racing 
after 7 months. Stepping into a race in 
the Tohoku region, carrying the pride of 
her hometown, Tomakomai.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hokko Tarumae appeared to be encouraged by 
Copano Rickey's earnest devotion and hard 
work.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"Even if it's been a while, there's no 
need to hold back. With their long-awaited 
rematch here, fighting spirit blazed in 
both of them."
